resources.string: Larger bubble text during a shift
Choose which delivery apps DashBuddy reads. Shift tracking works only in apps DashBuddy fully supports.

Saves your full history as spreadsheet files in a folder you choose:
deliveries.csv: one row per delivery
sessions.csv: one row per shift
summary.csv: totals and estimated IRS mileage deduction
expenses.csv: logged expenses, including undone ones
fuel.csv: logged fill-ups, including undone ones

The files include store names, your expense labels as you typed them and DashBuddy's tracked miles at each fill-up. Customer names and addresses, which DashBuddy keeps only as codes, are left out. DashBuddy doesn't upload them, but a cloud folder may. The files stay after you uninstall; delete them from the folder. Exporting again replaces them.
Exported %1$d files to the chosen folder.
Export failed (%1$s). Check the folder and try again.

Saves a bug report, dashbuddy-log.txt, to a folder you choose. It lists the app\'s main events, like offers and deliveries. DashBuddy replaces known private details first but can miss some, so read it before sharing. DashBuddy doesn\'t send it to the developer; a cloud folder may upload it. It stays after uninstall; delete it from the folder. Exporting again replaces it.
Exported dashbuddy-log.txt. Private details removed from %1$d lines.
Bug report export failed (%1$s). Check the folder and try again.

DashBuddy uses Android Accessibility to recognize offers, pickups and deliveries in the delivery apps you turn on, on your phone.

Each automatic tap below stays off until you allow it. It asks when a new one appears, and again if that button's layout changes. Nothing built in or downloaded turns one on by itself. Taps stay in the delivery app and must match the button's label, except the pay-details arrow, which has none.

Turning one off stops the automatic tap. Pressing Accept or Decline in DashBuddy still taps for you.

Choices are saved on this phone with their time, app version and privacy notice version, until you clear app data or uninstall. Backup and phone transfer skip them, so a new phone asks again.
No automatic taps yet. They show up when a delivery app supports them.
Press Accept in DashBuddy and it taps Accept or Add to route in %1$s, after checking the button\'s label there. Your press works even with this switched off.
Press Decline in DashBuddy and it taps Decline in %1$s, after checking the button\'s label there. Your press works even with this switched off.
If quick declines and this are both on, DashBuddy taps the second Decline in %1$s after you start a decline. It checks the label and stays inside %1$s.
DashBuddy taps the arrow on a finished %1$s delivery to read its pay breakdown for your records. The arrow has no label, so only the app is checked. Delivery, pay and settings don\'t change.
Every offer gets Accept, except shopping offers when Shopping offers is off
When off, shopping offers score Decline. Nothing is tapped for you.
After you tap Decline, DashBuddy taps the confirm button. Needs your OK under Automation & Consent.
Drag to reorder. Rules higher up count more.

Off unless you turn it on. A screenshot is saved only when this switch and its type below are on; the types start on.

A screenshot shows the whole screen, including customer details, other apps and anything else showing, like a video or the keyboard. It goes to Pictures/DashBuddy. DashBuddy never uploads it, but gallery sync or sharing can. Screenshots stay after you uninstall; delete them in your gallery.

None is taken if this switch is off or another app is in front at that moment; one already saving still finishes. This switch doesn't affect your shift history.
Which app the bubble shows when two delivery apps are online. In every mode, cards and the chat header name their app.
Shows the delivery app you used last. A pick in the bubble\'s switcher holds until that app\'s shift ends, then the bubble follows again.
Your switcher pick stays until you change it, even across that app\'s next shift. While that app is offline, the bubble shows the app you used last.
Test mode: one stack of cards from every app with a live shift, each labeled with its app. No switcher; the chat follows the app you used last.
Optional. If you don\'t allow it, DashBuddy still works, with events only from supported delivery apps. Change this in Settings > Data & privacy > Automation & consent.

Lets DashBuddy notice a delivery offer that pops up over another app, by getting screen events from every app.

Screen content is read and saved only from delivery apps you turn on; for other apps, DashBuddy sees only which app is open.

Offer screenshots are off unless you turn them on in Settings > Data & privacy. A screenshot saves the whole screen, including any app behind the offer, to Pictures/DashBuddy. DashBuddy never uploads it, but gallery sync or sharing can. Screenshots stay after you uninstall; delete them in your gallery.

DashBuddy records this choice on this phone with its time, app version and privacy notice version, and leaves it out of Android backup and phone transfer. The app log also notes each change; it leaves your phone only in a bug report you export. Turn Screen events off in %1$s.
On Android 11, this may not take effect.
See which other app is open

Forgets this phone\'s census install ID and secret, deletes the waiting outlines and captures, and turns capture sharing off. The next upload signs up a new install ID, which the census server must trust again. The Census upload switch stays as it is.

Sends the text of screens DashBuddy doesn\'t recognize to the census server while the server trusts this install. These screens get only the general privacy filters, so a capture can still hold customer details that the server\'s operator can read.
Highlights the bubble\'s Odometer button early in a shift, and after one until you log a reading
